channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Natixis buys Japanese advisory firm to join M&A dealmaking boom
item.description: Natixis has been working to expand in Japan, growing its sales and trading team, strengthening its lending business and opening a bank branch.

item.title: Japan launches probe in historic bid to collect sample from Mars moon
item.description: The five-year mission — the first to attempt to land on a Martian moon — could shed light on the origins of the solar system and life on Earth.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama vows fiscal prudence on defense funding
item.description: The remarks come after local media reported that the government was weighing an additional corporate tax hike to finance the measure.

item.title: Japan considering paper-digital hybrid textbooks as standard
item.description: The education ministry's plan calls for placing more emphasis on paper-based materials while giving a supplementary role to digital materials.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
